It preserves the single-file scope, timing and line-break focus, unchanged names and lyrics, caption order, prohibition on publishing photos, excluded deliverables, review-before-sharing condition, explanation-free return, and unchanged-file fallback. The consolidation introduces no material omission or new requirement.
